entities.summary: "A Moment Like This" is a song by American singer Kelly Clarkson, released as her debut single. The song was written by Jörgen Elofsson and John Reid from British house music project Nightcrawlers and produced by Stephen Ferrera and Steve Mac. The song was issued as a double A-side with "Before Your Love" as Clarkson's coronation single after winning the first season of American Idol. A remixed version of the song was later included on her debut studio album, Thankful (2003). "A Moment Like This" was a huge hit in North America, topping the US Billboard Hot 100 and the Canadian Singles Chart.
